SOLO HACKATHON PROJECTPlay browser demo ↗

RFID Abilities
Platformer

A speedrun platformer where scanning physical tokens changes your movement abilities. You can also play with a normal keyboard.

Role
Solo developer
Built with
Unity · C# · ESP32 · RFID
First version
2–3 day hackathon

I connected an RFID reader to an ESP32 that sends Bluetooth keyboard inputs to Unity. The game combines dash, wall jump, gravity flip and time stop.

01.A Inspect the system+

FROM OBJECT TO ACTION

  1. 01RFID token

    Stores an ability string.

  2. 02Reader + ESP32

    Reads the token and matches its ability.

  3. 03Bluetooth input

    Sends the corresponding number key.

  4. 04Unity ability

    Selects the movement ability in-game.

Unity receives ordinary keyboard input, so the same game works with or without the physical controller.

I'm Jamie, a computer science student at UQ. I enjoy building movement systems and exploring how a change in input or a single ability can change the way a game plays.

I'm drawn to games with atmosphere and a strong sense of place—NieR, Monster Hunter, and stories that stay with you.
